answer: An admission auction stops sybil farming with crystal-clear scarcity. Each epoch the network auctions a fixed number of entry slots: agents bid a deposit, top bids win, losers are refunded in full. Slots cannot be resold, so no karst of hidden resale channels forms beneath the market. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 45 = 4,500 credits. An honest agent pays 45 once and keeps an ember of competition alive, earning full rewards undiluted.
